sources.excerpt: Mojo Hand FX One Ton Bee – Coast Sonic Skip to content Search Home Shop Hi-Fives News Contact Account Search Cart Home Shop Hi-Fives News Contact Home Mojo Hand FX One Ton Bee Skip to product information Previous Next Close Mojo Hand FX One Ton Bee Regular price $120.00 USD More stock coming soon By Mojo Hand FX Quantity Add to cart Maker: Mojo Hand FX Model: One Ton Bee Condition: New Description: With the One Ton Bee, we’re taking you back to the Golden Age of fuzz. The One Ton Bee was inspired by the legendary fuzz pioneers The Ventures and their 60's fuzz tones. We’ve tweaked the circuit and added our own ‘mojo’ while staying true to the spirit of the highly revered original. In short, the One Ton Bee will please any and all players looking for that gnarly, nasty fuzz of yore, yet need something a bit more musical. This Bee is all sting and proud of it. The days of digging around online for quality vintage fuzz (along with spending an arm and a leg) are over. The One Ton Bee brings vintage fuzz screaming into the now.
